title: Display All AGV Active Paths on the Map Using Map Monitor Quick Select
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor Quick Select icon “View all AGV active paths” to overlay active AGV routes on the live map as small blue lines from each AGV to its intended destination.
when_to_use: When you need a visual confirmation of where each AGV is headed (active routes) on the live RMS map.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Map Monitor Quick Select action and interpret whether active-path blue lines appear as expected.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) with Map Monitor Quick Select panel

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the icon “View all AGV active paths” and related Quick Select icons (station IDs, charger IDs, and selection modes).

steps.title: Open Map Monitor Quick Select panel in RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Get to the Map Monitor Quick Select icons used to visualize AGV active paths.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), locate the left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel.
steps.expected_result: The left-side Map Monitor Quick Select panel is visible and includes the icon labeled “View all AGV active paths”.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Quick Select icons on the left panel, including “View all AGV active paths”.
steps.failure_condition: The Map Monitor Quick Select panel is not visible or the “View all AGV active paths” icon cannot be found.

actions.label: Locate Quick Select panel
actions.exact_action: Locate the left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “View all AGV active paths” shows active paths on the map as a small blue line that starts from the AGV and ends where the AGV wants to go.
Map Monitor Quick Select panel includes “View all AGV active paths” icon.

steps.title: Select “View all AGV active paths” icon
steps.purpose: Trigger the map overlay that displays all active AGV routes.
steps.instruction: Click the “View all AGV active paths” icon in the Map Monitor Quick Select panel.
steps.expected_result: Active AGV paths are displayed on the map as small blue lines, each starting from an AGV and ending at where that AGV wants to go.
steps.healthy_condition: For each AGV that has an active route, you see a small blue line from the AGV to its intended destination.
steps.failure_condition: No active-path blue lines appear on the map when AGVs are expected to be moving.

actions.label: Click View all AGV active paths
actions.exact_action: Click the “View all AGV active paths” icon in the Quick Select panel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the map shows no active-path blue lines while AGVs are expected to be moving, stop and escalate for further fleet status checks.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “View all AGV active paths” shows active paths on the map as a small blue line that starts from the AGV and ends up where the AGV wants to go.
Clicking the “View all AGV active paths” icon shows all active paths on the map as small blue lines from each AGV to its destination.

steps.title: Verify blue active-path overlays on the map
steps.purpose: Confirm the visualization matches the expected behavior for active routes.
steps.instruction: On the map, verify that active paths are displayed as small blue lines that start from each AGV and end at where that AGV wants to go.
steps.expected_result: The map displays small blue lines for all active AGV routes, each line starting at an AGV and ending at that AGV’s intended destination.
steps.healthy_condition: Blue lines are visible for active AGVs and each line’s endpoint corresponds to the AGV’s intended destination.
steps.failure_condition: Blue lines are missing or do not correspond to the AGV’s intended destination.

actions.label: Inspect map overlays
actions.exact_action: Verify that active paths are displayed as small blue lines that start from each AGV and end at where that AGV wants to go.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the map shows no blue lines while AGVs are expected to be moving, stop and escalate to deeper RMS/WCS checks.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “View all AGV active paths” shows active paths on the map as a small blue line that starts from the AGV and ends where the AGV wants to go.

success_criteria: On the RMS map, small blue lines appear for active AGV routes, each line starting at an AGV and ending at that AGV’s intended destination.
healthy_conditions: Active AGV routes are visible as small blue lines from each AGV to its intended destination.
failure_conditions: No active-path blue lines appear when AGVs are expected to be moving.
escalation_guidance: If no active-path blue lines appear while AGVs are expected to be moving, stop and escalate for further fleet status checks (deeper RMS/WCS checks).
